housingRentIncomeElasticity.citation: Income elasticity of housing spending, about 0.3 to 0.7 (Glaeser, Gyourko and Saks 2005; Davis and Ortalo-Magne 2011).

spread.citation: Income elasticity of housing spending, about 0.3 to 0.7 (Glaeser, Gyourko and Saks 2005; Davis and Ortalo-Magne 2011).

housingIncomeOffsetShare.citation: Households with little income still pay rent near the low end (HUD Fair Market Rent is the 40th percentile).

spread.citation: Households with little income still pay rent near the low end (HUD Fair Market Rent is the 40th percentile).

housingReviewDay.citation: Rent is due on the 1st; the review runs after the most common five-day grace period.

housingMortgageTermYears.citation: The 30-year fixed-rate loan is the benchmark U.S. home mortgage: FHFA MIRS table 26 reports it as its 30-year fixed contract series.

housingFirstTimeBuyerMedianAge.citation: NAR 2025 Profile of Home Buyers and Sellers: the median first-time buyer is 40 (data/research/housing/nar-2025-down-payments.json).

housingOwnerMinimumAge.citation: A householder signs for a home as an adult; 18 is the age of majority in most states.

housingBankMortgageShareOfLoans.citation: Loans secured by one-to-four family homes are about a quarter to a third of community banks' loans (FDIC Community Banking Study 2020 and Quarterly Banking Profile).

spread.citation: Loans secured by one-to-four family homes are about a quarter to a third of community banks' loans (FDIC Community Banking Study 2020 and Quarterly Banking Profile).

housingBuyBaseline.citation: How far buying sits below renting before cost and the down payment; checked against the ACS owner share and NAR's first-time buyer share of sales (21 percent in 2025).

spread.citation: How far buying sits below renting before cost and the down payment; checked against the ACS owner share and NAR's first-time buyer share of sales (21 percent in 2025).

housingBuyCostWeight.citation: Owning that costs more each month than renting pulls against buying, by the gap as a share of income.

spread.citation: Owning that costs more each month than renting pulls against buying, by the gap as a share of income.

housingBuyDownWeight.citation: Saving the down payment is the main barrier for first-time buyers (NAR 2025 Profile of Home Buyers and Sellers).

spread.unit: score per log of down payment over cash
spread.citation: Saving the down payment is the main barrier for first-time buyers (NAR 2025 Profile of Home Buyers and Sellers).

housingCounselPlanShareOfPay.citation: Repayment stipulations in housing court spread arrears over months the tenant can carry beyond rent; HUD's 30% rent-burden line leaves roughly a tenth of pay for arrears.

spread.citation: Repayment stipulations in housing court spread arrears over months the tenant can carry beyond rent; HUD's 30% rent-burden line leaves roughly a tenth of pay for arrears.

housingCounselPlanMaxMonths.citation: Negotiated repayment plans in housing court run a few months to a year; NYC OCJ FY25 report: 83% of fully represented households were allowed to remain.

spread.citation: Negotiated repayment plans in housing court run a few months to a year; NYC OCJ FY25 report: 83% of fully represented households were allowed to remain.

housingCounselCostPerCaseMinor.citation: NYC Dept. of Social Services, Office of Civil Justice, FY25 Annual Report (Dec 2025): tenant legal services $217.3M over 51,000 households served ($4,260) to 22,700 fully represented ($9,570).

housingSupplyElasticity.citation: Saiz (2010, QJE): metro housing supply elasticities from about 0.6 (constrained coasts) to over 3, near 1.75 on average.

spread.unit: starts per unit of value over cost
spread.citation: Saiz (2010, QJE): metro housing supply elasticities from about 0.6 (constrained coasts) to over 3, near 1.75 on average.

housingLandStartsElasticity.citation: Auckland's upzoning of about three quarters of residential land raised permits about 50% (Greenaway-McGrevy and Phillips 2023), ln 1.5 / ln 4; critics' 10% gives the low end.

spread.unit: starts per share of land where building is allowed
spread.citation: Auckland's upzoning of about three quarters of residential land raised permits about 50% (Greenaway-McGrevy and Phillips 2023), ln 1.5 / ln 4; critics' 10% gives the low end.

housingUnitsPerBuilding.citation: Census Building Permits Survey 2024: units per permitted building in 5+ unit structures run about 20 to 30 by state.

spread.citation: Census Building Permits Survey 2024: units per permitted building in 5+ unit structures run about 20 to 30 by state.

housingMaterialsShareOfCost.citation: NAHB Construction Cost Survey 2024: materials and trades bought by the builder are about half of a new home's construction cost.

spread.citation: NAHB Construction Cost Survey 2024: materials and trades bought by the builder are about half of a new home's construction cost.

housingRentVacancyElasticity.citation: Natural-vacancy rent adjustment (Gabriel and Nothaft 1988, 2001); no readable U.S. estimate, kept small; new 50+ unit buildings lower nearby rents about 6% (Asquith, Mast and Reed 2023).

spread.unit: rent change per share change in vacancy
spread.citation: Natural-vacancy rent adjustment (Gabriel and Nothaft 1988, 2001); no readable U.S. estimate, kept small; new 50+ unit buildings lower nearby rents about 6% (Asquith, Mast and Reed 2023).

housingNewHomeSupplyMonths.citation: Census New Residential Sales, 2024: new single-family homes for sale ran about 8 to 9 months' supply at the current sales rate.

spread.citation: Census New Residential Sales, 2024: new single-family homes for sale ran about 8 to 9 months' supply at the current sales rate.

housingNoticeBaseline.citation: Landlords usually wait until a tenant owes two or more months of rent before filing (Humphries, Nelson, Nguyen, van Dijk and Waldinger, NBER w33155, 2024); 14.4% of renters are behind at a time, most by about a month (Census Household Pulse Survey 2024, Housing Tables 1b and 3b). Set so a month's pull is about 0.15 at one month owed and 0.7 at two; checked against Eviction Lab 2018 filing rates (7.8 per 100 renter households nationally). Gathered in data/research/housing/eviction-filings-2026.json.

spread.unit: logit of a month's pull to serve notice

housingAssistanceRentShareOfIncome.citation: HUD Housing Choice Voucher program: the family's share of rent is generally 30% of adjusted monthly income (24 CFR 982.505, 982.515).

housingIndividualShareSmallHomes.citation: Census Rental Housing Finance Survey 2021 (CRS R47332, 2022; HUD release pr22-242): individual investors own most rental units in properties of four or fewer units (70.2%), LLCs, LPs and LLPs most units in the largest properties.

spread.citation: Census Rental Housing Finance Survey 2021 (CRS R47332, 2022; HUD release pr22-242): individual investors own most rental units in properties of four or fewer units (70.2%), LLCs, LPs and LLPs most units in the largest properties.

housingIndividualShareAll.citation: Census Rental Housing Finance Survey 2021: individual investors own 37.6% of rental units (CRS R47332, Ownership of the U.S. Rental Housing Stock by Investor Type, 2022).

housingNoticeFirmWeight.citation: Firm landlords file evictions more readily than individual owners: 8% likelier with controls in Fulton County, Georgia (Raymond, Duckworth, Miller, Lucas and Pokharel 2016, Atlanta Fed discussion paper 2016-4), 186% more filings in Boston for owners of 15 or more properties (Gomory).

spread.citation: Firm landlords file evictions more readily than individual owners: 8% likelier with controls in Fulton County, Georgia (Raymond, Duckworth, Miller, Lucas and Pokharel 2016, Atlanta Fed discussion paper 2016-4), 186% more filings in Boston for owners of 15 or more properties (Gomory).

housingRefinanceBaseline.citation: How far refinancing sits below keeping the loan before what it saves; checked against 2021, when refinancings came to about a fifth of mortgage debt outstanding (MBA 2021 refinance originations of about $2.3 trillion against about $11.5 trillion outstanding, Federal Reserve Z.1), and against owners who don't refinance when it would pay (Keys, Pope and Pope 2016, about 20 percent).

spread.citation: How far refinancing sits below keeping the loan before what it saves; checked against 2021, when refinancings came to about a fifth of mortgage debt outstanding (MBA 2021 refinance originations of about $2.3 trillion against about $11.5 trillion outstanding, Federal Reserve Z.1), and against owners who don't refinance when it would pay (Keys, Pope and Pope 2016, about 20 percent).

housingRefinanceGainWeight.citation: How strongly an owner weighs what a refinance saves over the years they'd keep the loan against its closing costs, in log terms (Agarwal, Driscoll and Laibson 2013: the optimal rate gap rises with closing costs and falls with the expected time in the loan).

spread.unit: score per log of savings over costs
spread.citation: How strongly an owner weighs what a refinance saves over the years they'd keep the loan against its closing costs, in log terms (Agarwal, Driscoll and Laibson 2013: the optimal rate gap rises with closing costs and falls with the expected time in the loan).

housingRefinanceHorizonMonths.citation: The months an owner expects to keep a new loan when weighing a refinance: mortgages are typically paid off or refinanced within five to seven years (Freddie Mac; Agarwal, Driscoll and Laibson 2013 use an expected real mortgage life near ten years at 2013 rates).

spread.citation: The months an owner expects to keep a new loan when weighing a refinance: mortgages are typically paid off or refinanced within five to seven years (Freddie Mac; Agarwal, Driscoll and Laibson 2013 use an expected real mortgage life near ten years at 2013 rates).

housingRefinanceCostShare.citation: Closing costs of a refinance as a share of the loan, rolled into the new balance: Freddie Mac puts them at about 2 to 5 percent of the loan; ClosingCorp's 2021 national average was about $2,400 before taxes, near 1 percent of an average refinance.

spread.citation: Closing costs of a refinance as a share of the loan, rolled into the new balance: Freddie Mac puts them at about 2 to 5 percent of the loan; ClosingCorp's 2021 national average was about $2,400 before taxes, near 1 percent of an average refinance.

housingTenureCountyWeightHomes.citation: How many homes' worth of its county's owner share a place's own ACS owner share is weighed against: a place with few homes in the 5-year sample (a third of places count under 200, often 100% or 0% owner-occupied) leans toward its county, a large one keeps its own (ACS 5-year margins of error for small places).

spread.citation: How many homes' worth of its county's owner share a place's own ACS owner share is weighed against: a place with few homes in the 5-year sample (a third of places count under 200, often 100% or 0% owner-occupied) leans toward its county, a large one keeps its own (ACS 5-year margins of error for small places).
